title: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Family Law) Rules 2021
converter: p2au_cth_fetch.py (same conversion as workbench harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py): word/document.xml paragraphs one per line, table-of-contents paragraphs dropped, Chapter/Part/Division headings as '\tPart N — Title'; multi-volume compilations joined with repeated front matter removed

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.converter: cth_convert_sym_v3.py (a copy of docx_text() and the volume joining of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py, changed only to map Word symbol characters, including the Wingdings tick; kept outside the repository)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word file, F2025C00594, refetched from the Federal Register of Legislation; its sha256 is this deposit's download_sha256 (ad732a3380f76a7a91982b2e512f802a775c3eb8a75e43b38e2b3f6dd844c111)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() in harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py read only w:t, w:tab, w:br/w:cr and w:noBreakHyphen, so it dropped every Word <w:sym> character. This compilation sets 336 characters that way, all the Wingdings tick F0FC: two in the text of r 14.03 and 334 in the delegation table of Schedule 4 clause 2. Each tick in the table sat alone in its cell, so the cell's line vanished and the deposit no longer showed which powers are delegated. cth_convert_sym_v3.py maps the tick to U+2713 (✓), Symbol-font characters to their Unicode characters (· × − • ≤ ≥ ° ′ — ÷ ±), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; none but the tick occur here.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: 336 characters, nothing else. Lines 4603-4604, r 14.03(1) and (2): "marked with a tick (✓) in column 3/4" (was "a tick ()"). Schedule 4 clause 2: 334 lines "✓" inserted, each after the description of power (column 2) of its item, one per ticked cell, in column order: 148 items are ticked in both column 3 (Senior Judicial Registrar) and column 4 (Judicial Registrar), so two lines; 38 are ticked in column 3 only, so one line. In the Word table no item is ticked in column 4 alone, so a single ✓ always means column 3. Line numbers up to 5275 are unchanged; later lines move down (old line 6079, the last tick's item, is now 6411; the deposit now has 6900 lines, was 6566).
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.checked: the same copy with symbol mapping switched off (--nomap) reproduces the previous deposit byte for byte (sha256 53087b65e2d67963d04b43d51c3690056591d52e67c3942a37633bd6112a5abf); the diff against it is the 2 changed and 334 inserted lines above, and only by the restored ticks
